summary: PhotoPrism is a self-hosted private photo management server: it indexes photos and videos into a searchable library, organizes them into albums, labels, places, faces and people (subjects), and exposes a REST API (photos, albums, labels, subjects, faces, markers, sessions, links, WebDAV/remote services) over SQLite/MySQL tables. Sign in with a username and password; most operations require an authenticated session and are scoped to the signed-in user's own library.
